evals.prompt: Add a new API endpoint GET /api/v1/health that returns status ok and current server uptime.
evals.expected_output: The skill inspects existing API conventions, writes the endpoint using smallest safe diff, and verifies the build exit code.
expectations: The skill inspects project-context.json and existing routes to match module and export conventions
A git checkpoint or stash is created before multi-file edits
The build and typecheck commands are executed and exit code 0 is verified

evals.prompt: Scaffold a new Next.js 15 app with TypeScript, TailwindCSS, and ESLint in greenfield mode.
evals.expected_output: The skill uses official non-interactive CLI generator commands to initialize the project in ./.
expectations: Official non-interactive generator command is executed with -y flag in ./
The scaffolded structure matches official Next.js App Router layout conventions
No existing files outside the scaffolded directory are modified or destroyed

evals.prompt: Install lodash-es dependency and use it to group tasks by priority in our TaskBoard component.
evals.expected_output: The skill flags adding lodash-es as MEDIUM risk with justification, installs it, updates code matching style, and runs lint/typecheck.
expectations: Adding new dependency is logged as MEDIUM risk with explicit justification
Component edits match existing TypeScript types and styling conventions
Typecheck and lint commands pass clean with exit code 0
